'''Thera Capens''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was the mistress of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]], who threatened her friends to secure her services. She was rescued by [[Stevan Makintay]], who captured the Major and agreed to take Capens off-world so that she could escape any Imperial reprisals.<ref name="J10" />
